# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Mask filtered glyph correctness**

## Highlights

Upcoming SkiaSharp 4.157 updates harden mask-filtered glyph rendering when consecutive font loads disagree. Native fixes handle changed outlines, incompatible mask formats and clipped embossed glyphs without changing managed APIs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Render the reloaded glyph** — Mask filtering now uses the reloaded glyph's own outline and format, falling back to raster generation when no outline exists instead of using stale path data. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
- **Validate mask copies and preserve embossed planes** — Incompatible mask formats or non-overlapping bounds produce cleared output rather than unsafe copies or assertions. Clipped embossed glyphs preserve each plane's full stride and clear uncovered regions. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
